summary: Our project simulates the moon, displaying potential landing sites all around the moon. The sites are then ranked from best to worst, on its power generation and communication window, on that day and time, with priority to power generation. The user is able to select the date and time, and can select a certain site to pin it and compare it to others later.
details: We use godot and GDscript to simulate the moon, and using the Horizons System data, we display the communication windows and potential power generations of each site. We used github so we could collaborate with others.
